proposals.evidence: Full cōkṣa explicitly gives Gujarati cokhā rice, Sindhi cokho cleaned rice and Kachhi caukhā rice, alongside Prakrit cokkha/cukkha. These support the western cukhā/cukkā/cukā/tsoka/sukhā rice responses. The semantic development is documented rather than inferred only from clean. Source affricate/sibilant, aspiration, gemination, vowels and internal spacing remain intact; local phonetic history and cross-IA transmission are qualified. Exact response: cukhā.
